summary: Whatcom County lookout site: 1929 pole platform, 1954 40-ft DNR tower, removed or destroyed in 1968. Footings can be found tossed over the side at the south end; both summits now hold communication towers.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com spell the lookout Entwhistle; Willhite spells the summit and man Entwistle. The story uses the register's spelling.

notes_for_editor: Record height 12.2 m matches the 1954 40-foot tower; the 1929 structure was 50 ft. Elevation 815.6 m matches 2,676 ft. The fate word differs: register says removed in 1968, firelookout.com and Willhite say destroyed. Staffing is one named lookout (Junia Buchanan to 1960); Willhite's phrase 'The first lookout' is ambiguous about whether it means first in the 1954 cab or first ever. Access level 'public' rests on the Mountaineers trail-status note and Willhite's gated-road caption; the summit road is gated. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the dedication title is Willhite's 'first fire warden in all the west'; the summary and status now say removed or destroyed, matching the register and the story. Footings wording now matches Willhite's 'can be found tossed'.
